# apple_release_version (Action)

Releases an approved App Store version that is waiting for release (Pending Developer Release) because its `release_type` is `MANUAL`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_release_version" "ios" {
  config {
    version_id = apple_app_store_version.ios.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.
